summary: Tested MantMed 'Password dimenticata' feature end-to-end: backend API (/api/auth/password/forgot, /reset/{token}, /reset) and frontend flows for /portale, /app, /admin + /reimposta-password. All 7 backend tests pass (3 existing + 4 new). All frontend data-testid selectors present and behaving as spec'd: forgot link visible, portal shows CF-friendly placeholder, doctor shows email-only, generic success message, child CF RCCRRA22M47H224F generates reset for linked parent, rate limit returns 429 after 10 req/h, invalid/expired tokens return 410 with 'Link non valido' page, strength validation live, confirm match hint works, submit disabled until strong+match, success routes to correct portal (/portale vs /app), sessions closed after reset, doctor 2FA remains active (mfa_required on new password login). Mobile 390px and desktop 1440px both render correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: password_reset.py: _mask('') would raise on empty email partition - defensive but low risk, user record always has email.
forgot endpoint uses asyncio.create_task without awaiting - fire-and-forget means test for CF path had to poll; acceptable since response must be generic/fast.
Rate limit is per-IP only (10/h) + per-user (3/window). Could add CF-based throttling to avoid username enumeration via timing but response is already generic.
login_attempts cleanup after reset uses regex on identifier - fine but ties implementation to key format; a dedicated field would be cleaner.
